data.name: LIRO: Divine Corruption
data.detailed_description:
LHOKA TRULY AT STAKE NOW

Bloodveil War corrupts The Divine Water and destroys not only the people but also Lhoka, which once used to be an alluring world. Death has become a repeated tragedy that could be encountered nearly everywhere.

In a world where chaos screams without mercy after the deadly Bloodveil War, Liro must find a way between reviving his family and seeking revenge.


A TOUGH SOULS-LIKE COMBAT

Liro: Divine Corruption is an action RPG where Southeast Asian myths meet Souls-like combat. As you explore the devastating Lhoka, you’ll have to face corrupted enemies with their different strengths and weaknesses.

Equip the gears, sharpen your combat abilities, and pay attention carefully to your surroundings.


THE SKY GETS DARKER

Divine Corruption has become a real and haunting occurrence hovering all over Lhoka in the most tragic way. Embark the journey with Liro to discover the way of purifying the corrupted Divine Water before Lhoka fully crumbles into ashes.

EXPLORE THE GRIM WORLD

Explore the now grim Lhoka surrounded by its terrifying enemies and corrupted landscapes. Master your combat skills and learn the enemies’ weaknesses to survive in Lhoka, all while trying to unravel its world’s mysteries.

data.short_description: Liro: Divine Corruption is an action RPG inspired by Southeast Asian (SEA) mythology where Bloodveil War causes Lhoka in total chaos. Explore the corrupted world featuring Souls-like combat, sacred beasts to help exploration and fight enemies, as well as a freely customizable skill system.
data.supported_languages:
English*, Indonesian
*languages with full audio support

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 1600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 6GB / AMD Radeon RX 580 8GB
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 80 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Windows Compatible Audio Device
  • Additional Notes: HDD Supported, SSD Recommended. The above specifications were tested with DLSS/FSR/XeSS enabled.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-9700 / AMD Ryzen 5 5500
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2060 / AMD Radeon RX 5700 XT / INTEL Arc A750
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 80 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Windows Compatible Audio Device
  • Additional Notes: SSD Required. The above specifications were tested with DLSS/FSR/XeSS enabled.
